"};function photo(p){return embeddedImages[p.image]}
function toast(s){const e=document.getElementById('toast');e.textContent=s;e.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toast.timer);toast.timer=setTimeout(()=>e.classList.remove('show'),3200)}
function navigate(route){location.hash='#'+route;if(location.hash==='#'+route)routePage();}
function currentRoute(){return decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)||'home')}
function scrollUp(){window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'})}
function updateBadges(){const c=state.cart.reduce((n,i)=>n+i.qty,0);document.getElementById('cart-count').textContent=c;document.getElementById('drawer-count').textContent=`(${c})`;const w=document.getElementById('wish-count');w.textContent=state.wishlist.length;w.hidden=!state.wishlist.length}
function headerActive(route){document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x.dataset.nav===route.split('/')[0]));}
function titlebar(kicker,title,action=''){return `<div class="section-titlebar"><div><span class="eyebrow red">${kicker}</span><h2 class="headline section-heading">${title}</h2></div>${action}</div>`}
function card(p){let saved=state.wishlist.includes(p.id);return `<article class="product-card"><div class="product-media" onclick="navigate('product/${p.id}')" role="link" tabindex="0" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')navigate('product/${p.id}')"><img loading="lazy" alt="${escapeHTML(p.name)} concept photograph" src="${photo(p)}"><span class="tag">${p.tag}</span><button aria-label="${saved?'Remove from':'Add to'} wishlist" class="wish-btn ${saved?'saved':''}" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleWish('${p.id}')"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20.8 4.6a5.2 5.2 0 0 0-7.4 0L12 6 10.6 4.6a5.2 5.2 0 0 0-7.4 7.3L12 21l8.8-9.1a5.2 5.2 0 0 0 0-7.3Z"/></svg></button><button class="quick-btn" onclick="event.stopPropagation();quickView('${p.id}')">Quick view +</button></div><div class="product-info"><div><h3 class="product-title"><a href="#product/${p.id}">${p.name}</a></h3><span class="product-type">${p.category}</span></div><span class="price">${money(p.price)}</span></div></article>`}
function tiles(items){return `<div class="product-grid">${items.length?items.map(card).join(''):'<div class="empty-state"><h3>Nothing here just yet.</h3><p>Try another filter or search.</p><button class="btn outline" onclick="resetFilters()">Show all pieces →</button></div>'}</div>`}

<div class="marquee"><span class="marquee-track">NOT MADE TO BLEND IN <em>✦</em> WALK YOUR OWN WAY <em>✦</em> NEW PERSPECTIVE <em>✦</em> NOT MADE TO BLEND IN <em>✦</em> WALK YOUR OWN WAY <em>✦</em> NEW PERSPECTIVE <em>✦</em></span></div>
<section class="section container" id="arrivals">${titlebar('01 / New arrivals','THE STRIPES<br>COLLECTION',`<a href="#shop" class="link-arrow">View full collection <span>→</span></a>`)}${tiles(catalog.slice(0,4))}</section>
